body: CI for 390e001: `home.test.ts` "sati activity --follow" fails on windows-latest (node 24 and 26) with `expected null to be 0`. Node on Windows ends a child at once for `kill("SIGINT")`; no handler runs. The command is correct at a real console. Fix the test only. The macOS failure in the same run (bare sati menu, status 247) was the pty-run race fixed in dfa30a0.

completion.summary: Test only. The two `activity --follow` tests now expect exit 0 after SIGINT everywhere but Windows, where Node ends the child at once and the close code is null. Lint, typecheck and all unit tests pass locally; Windows result is checked by CI on the pushed commit.

title: CI red on Windows: activity --follow tests expect exit 0 after a signal Windows cannot deliver
